title: Enterprise deploy pipeline without explicit target object
operational_setting: A deployment service promotes a software build from staging to production using ordinary CI/CD configuration and tests.
trust_boundary: The deployment service changes production state on behalf of the software team.
intended_transition: Version N+1 is accepted as production-ready and deployed.

attack.procedure: Operate the full workflow without an explicit target-state object and measure whether completion semantics remain unambiguous across independent tools.

success_criteria_for_attack: If pipeline artifacts fully and portably define acceptable completion without reconstructing target semantics, the claim for a distinct target object is weakened.

verdict.rationale: Tests semantic portability, not whether deployment itself can work.
